content: GA4+GTM: use @next/third-parties/google's <GoogleTagManager/> component plus sendGTMEvent({event: 'rfq_submit', ...params}) for custom events; GA4 best practice is snake_case custom event names when no recommended-event name fits. Plausible: cookieless, custom events fired via window.plausible('event_name', {props}) or a script-tag data attribute, no consent banner needed. Both support arbitrary named events, so a thin wrapper function (trackEvent(name, props)) that no-ops until a vendor script is mounted keeps call sites vendor-agnostic.
